title: Wave A Wand Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Wave a Wand is a new, modern 1-bedroom cottage located on Savannah Street that is perfect for 2 people who want to get away from it all.
description_expanded: 29 Savannah StreetModern Coastal Cottage Steps from the BeachWave a Wand is a beautifully designed, newly built one-bedroom cottage located just 174 feet from private beach access on Savannah Street in Seaside, Florida. Thoughtfully crafted for couples seeking a refined coastal escape, this modern retreat blends clean architectural lines with breezy seaside charm. Its prime location places you within a four-minute walk of the Seaside Amphitheater and Central Square, home to more than 35 beloved shops, cafés, and restaurants.Light-Filled Living with Contemporary ComfortInside, the open living area welcomes you with airy coastal décor, plush seating, and a large wall-mounted Plasma TV with TiVo, creating the perfect space to unwind after a day at the beach. The modern kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring a center island with bar seating for two, custom built-in cabinetry, pantry storage, and an adjacent sunlit dining area that comfortably seats four. A convenient half bath on the main level adds ease for entertaining and everyday living.Inviting Outdoor Spaces & Thoughtful DetailsStep outside to enjoy a charming wooden deck framed by vibrant azaleas, along with a designated parking space and bike rack for easy exploring. The front porch offers seating for two and serves as an ideal spot for morning coffee, afternoon breezes, and the gentle soundtrack of nearby waves rolling ashore.Serene Primary Suite with Private BalconyUpstairs, the tranquil queen primary bedroom feels like a private treehouse retreat, complete with a balcony tucked among the treetops—perfect for enjoying peaceful views and coastal breezes. The luxurious en-suite bath features marble walls, a glass-enclosed tub and shower combination with a rain shower, a single vanity, and abundant natural light. A second hallway guest bath with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower adds extra convenience and privacy, while a washer and dryer on this level make longer stays effortless.Walkable Location Near Everything SeasideA private footpath from the front porch leads directly to the beach in under five minutes, offering easy access to Seaside’s sugar-white sand and crystal-clear Gulf waters. With its contemporary design, thoughtful layout, and unbeatable walkability, Wave a Wand is a serene coastal hideaway just moments from the best of Seaside, Florida.* Adults only, no children, please.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,012 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, just steps from the beachSeaside Private Residential Beach access at Savannah Pavilion, the largest private residential beach on 30AIncredible walkability: just 1 minute (175 feet) to beach access and a 4-minute walk to the Seaside Amphitheater and downtown Central SquarePrivate driveway and bike rack for guest convenienceFull-size washer and dryerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking policy: One parking pass issued for one-bedroom cottages. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf cart restrictions: Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002140
